rows.text: # Contrastive attribution: component and integration checkpoint

2026-09-12. General ATTN-001 remains OPEN. Lifecycle B and attribution-gated credit
remain accepted. Primary-agent review under the user's autonomous authorization.
## Implemented and reviewed

The [component contract](../formal/CONTRASTIVE_ATTRIBUTION_COMPONENT.md) names
`contrastive-attribution-component/0.1-candidate`. It tests a fallible repeated
motion/stationary contrast: two trials of each kind, identical observed starting
intervals, and strict conservative separation of subsequent level-change intervals.
Only Supported/Unavailable is produced. There is no confidence, effect magnitude,
belief lookup, persistent write or conscious-belief prerequisite.

The rule adds replicated contrast beyond simple temporal proximity, but cannot
exclude hidden confounding. It is a candidate implicit attribution mechanism, not
proof of actual intervention efficacy. Net observed change remains distinct from
Applied and from pressure relief. The stationary cases are part of its evidence
basis; selecting only favourable trials is forbidden in eventual source admission.

[Current component tests](CONTRASTIVE_ATTRIBUTION_TESTS_REV2.json): CA-A..I pass.
Revision1 preserves the earlier test run before the explicit unbalanced-count case.
[Adversarial review](CONTRASTIVE_ATTRIBUTION_REVIEW_REV1.json): six actual in-memory
source substitutions detected by named witnesses: inclusive contrast, optimistic
interval endpoints, ignored baseline, ignored replication, omitted positive-change
requirement and sparse-coordinate admission. Source files were not replaced on disk.

CA-H establishes only function-level equality for identical supplied operands with
different hypothetical hidden explanations. It does not qualify an actual public
false-attribution source. That stronger obligation remains open. The component's
positive result cannot authorize any memory write on its own.
## Actual selector integration finding

Two additional IA-B tests use the installed SEM assembly and actual attention pool,
selector and selected-capability consumer. A valid support-only SEM experience has
one observation but zero event/continuant units. It selects nothing even at capacity2;
requesting its observation through the selected view rejects.

This matches actual EMB runtime source: its present sample461/462 produces a frozen
support-only227 at14, with no perceived bindings or event-files, then pressure at60.
It is not a failed observation, and its direct current pressure path remains qualified.
It simply is not an admitted durable unit in the current attention/memory proposal.

[Combined revision2 report](ATTENTION_ATTRIBUTION_INTEGRATION_TESTS_REV2.json):24 tests
pass across five files (9 attribution,2 selector boundary,6 consolidation fixture,
4 retained barrier,3 effect non-identifiability). Revision1 is preserved: its two new
tests failed because their fixture used an unadmitted unsuffixed SEM version. Correcting
the fixture to the actual EMB `semantic-binding/0.1-candidate#SEM-001H` fixed that
test setup; no production codec/admission was relaxed.
## Integration work prepared and remaining

The contrastive source needs retained pre/post body evidence and observable movement
for the same perceived candidate. Existing marker continuity is fallible and may be
reused only through its authentic producer; it is not proof of a causal relation.
No raw truth or occurrence ordering can choose the target or match the trials.

SEM222 has exact event feature values but the current closed feature vocabulary has
no general contact or stroke primitive. Prior position proposals expose one coordinate
per detection. A source describing a motion segment requires exact permitted
observation semantics, not a caller-authored Supported flag or an arbitrary pair of
unrelated snapshots. No such public feature source has been implemented here.

The next integration also needs a disposition for body evidence entering durable
memory. Appending numeric body samples as an unrestricted companion to selected
visual content would bypass the current positive-retention boundary. Manufacturing
an event-file/body continuant or causal role to fit the old key would redefine SEM.
The [interoceptive encoding decision](GENERAL_ATTENTION_INTEROCEPTIVE_ENCODING_DECISION.md)
therefore fixes the concrete capacity/topology choice before new source records.

No permanent allocation, public model, source admission, history store, consolidation
write, restore qualification or corpus promotion occurred. No historical mechanism
was retired. The prior public attention preservation receipt remains independent.
# Outcome attribution: first contract decomposition

2026-09-12. **DRAFT, not whole-shape accepted.** Implements no public transition and
proposes no permanent number. Consumes the [accepted credit ruling](GENERAL_ATTENTION_CONSOLIDATION_CREDIT_RESOLUTION.md).
## Minimum semantic result
Keep three questions separate:

| Question | Owning operation | What a positive result licenses |
|---|---|---|
| Is this encoded episode supported as connected to this experienced outcome? | OutcomeAttributionAssessment | Eligibility for this causal-credit path |
| What effect is supported by the permitted evidence? | Separately specified effect assessment | Only the measurement/estimate meaning its contract proves |
| What changes in memory follow? | Consolidation assessment and registered mutation owner | Only the accepted memory update |

Attribution must not manufacture the operands for the other two questions. In
particular Supported does not mean exact effect, positive benefit, correct prediction,
reward, success, factual causal certainty or a guaranteed nonzero memory change.

The thinnest proposed first result domain is Supported / Unavailable. Unavailable
has no magnitude, confidence or Boolean causal judgment. Supported has no numeric
effect or invented confidence. A future contrary-attribution state is not mapped to
either zero effect or a retroactive deletion; its law remains separate.

This two-state candidate does not deny uncertainty in the architecture. It merely
avoids claiming calibrated degrees before a source and numerical rule exist.
## Source and target authentication before assessment

The public receiver must authenticate actual producer/child binding before PRJ/IDN
or memory access. Validate a retained target by qualified character, observer and
its existing selection occurrence. A bare occurrence, archive record or caller-
supplied valid-looking retained encoding cannot mint the capability. Retained
content excludes unencoded units; linking by selection does not permit reading
the original full selected envelope.

Consume the accepted consequence227 →269 →270 path unchanged. Numeric observation
payloads, if needed by a later assessment, require their own producer-qualified
carriage. Merely citing observation IDs in227 provides no payload resolver. Do not
broaden CharacterEvidenceRef or copy truth dispatch ancestry into cognitive input.

An absent outcome opportunity can publish authenticated no-outcome status through
an explicitly registered branch. It must not create a fabricated227,269 or270.
If the eventual profile simply schedules no assessment when no outcome is observed,
that silence is not itself a character assertion of absence. The exact branch choice
must be fixed in the public output/occurrence inventory, not left to an adapter.

Same-instant targets require a separately admitted positive-retention proposal with
the exact selection address; the barrier validates its corresponding base formation
and consumes it once. This is an explicit composition input, not a memory read of
an uncommitted sibling. Later-instant targets require the actual committed episode.
## First source investigation: observable interaction, not a causal label

Investigate a bounded interaction source whose raw features describe observable
motion/contact and a device's visible response. The character rule may interpret
that interaction together with an experienced outcome as support for a connection.
It must be possible for the device's response and bodily change to have independent
hidden causes. The source may never emit “caused relief,” “effective,” “creditable,”
an episode address selected by hidden provenance, or an authored per-object weight.

This is an investigation proposal, not an accepted attribution law. In particular,
an observed device response is not automatically evidence of its connection to a
body change. The next source review must state the exact fallible inferential rule
and what observable feature beyond temporal proximity supports its conclusion.
If that rule needs prior knowledge, inspect and contract that prior separately;
do not impose a belief store by naming the assessment or relabel diagnostic-level
prediction as causal knowledge.

The experiment must hold acquired episode, permitted outcome, time and body evidence
fixed while varying only permitted interaction/connection evidence. A second pair
holds all admitted evidence fixed while changing hidden causal truth. The former
must distinguish supported from unavailable under the candidate rule; the latter
must preserve the assessment, including when it is objectively wrong.

Physical truth generation, sensory permission and character inference must each
have separately testable outputs. Existing glyph continuity can connect perceived
continuants across views but cannot by itself prove event-to-outcome causality.
Exact observable features, feature-source lifecycle, observer-safe event pairing,
record shapes and the inference rule are still missing. No canonical source is
implemented until those are whole-shape reviewed and allocated separately.
## Adversarial review of this decomposition

The accepted ruling corrects a potential overconstraint in the decision discussion:
explicit attribution does not require an explicit causal belief. This draft therefore
adds no belief read, belief write or same-event belief order, and does not decide
ORD-001. The suggested interaction experiment remains a hypothesis subject to the
source review above, not a manufactured positive witness.

The earlier body counterexamples remain valid even after Supported attribution:
two equal safe bin pairs can hide Applied10 versus1. Neither source authentication
nor a Supported tag can turn those equal inputs into different hidden-effect values.
Outcome magnitude/surprise and the update law remain separate work. The former32
draft attention recipes have neither this source nor these assessment stages; their
registrations, model commitments and work estimates cannot be reused as closure.

Next: inspect existing permitted feature carriers and physical producer conventions,
then specify a falsifiable interaction-to-attribution rule with an inhabited
supported-wrong case. No weakening of the source gate, general attention completion
or corpus promotion is proposed.
# Separate body acquisition: component checkpoint

2026-09-12. Primary-agent review under autonomous authorization. General ATTN-001
remains OPEN. The separate-gate ruling is recorded in its forward resolution.
## Implemented bounded control

`interoceptive-selection-component/0.1-candidate` validates and detaches actual
EMB461/463 values, requires one observer/instant and unique observation/channel IDs,
then applies capacity0..2 to at most three candidates. Equal priority and canonical
channel tie order are explicit control semantics. Absent samples are ineligible;
present samples are not filtered out merely because current pressure would be zero.

Only selected canonical bytes enter the opaque one-use view. The trace-side audit
contains identities/dispositions, not a payload resolver. Input mutation, copied or
forged views, reuse and closing are tested. No private full observation history is
retained by the view. No permanent memory representation or source authority is
claimed by this component.

[Seven tests pass](INTEROCEPTIVE_SELECTION_TESTS_REV2.json); the preceding revision1
failed in fixture construction because rational denominators were omitted. The fixture
was corrected, not the canonical rational contract. [Six actual source substitutions](INTEROCEPTIVE_SELECTION_REVIEW_REV1.json)
are detected: retain-all, ignore-capacity, select-absent, reusable view, ignored
observer/time and duplicate channels. This qualifies IB-A..G at component scope only.

The cross-modal test varies the actual visual selector's candidates while keeping
body component inputs fixed. The within-body test adds candidates that displace the
previously sole selected sample. These exercise distinct component paths; they do
not qualify an integrated public multi-channel producer or durable acquisition.
## Source granularity finding

Current EMB has one reserve anchor and one selected body signal/channel in its frozen
public profile. Its461 payload has observation, observer, channel, instant and interval,
but no safe physiological-signal grouping key. Distinct channel IDs alone cannot prove
different underlying bodily quantities. The component intentionally makes no such claim.

Two further tests use actual reserveBin, EMB codec and the new selector. With hidden
reserve27 and capacity100, channels of widths1/5/10 yield27..28,25..30 and20..30.
The sample-level control treats these as three candidates; at capacity2 the third
loses acquisition. Giving all three channels the same width still consumes two slots
and displaces the remaining duplicate readout. This is the defined control behavior,
not a selector implementation defect or proof of distinct bodily sensations.

[Combined report](INTEROCEPTIVE_ACQUISITION_COMPONENT_TESTS_REV1.json):20 tests pass
across body selection7, granularity2, retained contrastive attribution9 and retained
support-only attention boundary2. Previous24-test receipts retain their own scopes.
No test count is promoted to a full-suite or public-memory claim.

The [candidate-unit decision](GENERAL_ATTENTION_INTEROCEPTIVE_UNIT_DECISION.md) therefore
needs a disposition before public source packaging. Adding arbitrary aliases of the
one existing sensor solely to satisfy “capacity+1” would conceal this resource-model
choice. Selecting a signal-group unit instead requires explicit safe grouping and an
inhabited multi-signal source. Existing raw physiology, pressure and visual contracts
remain unchanged under either choice.
## Durable representation work prepared

The recommended layout direction after unit closure is a peer retained acquisition
in the ordinary episodic family, with an immutable admitted sample basis and declared
formation authority. It must use existing observation identities for its operands,
qualified CharacterId for ownership, and a governed later memory reader. No generic
archive resolver or fabricated perceptual body continuant is needed. Its precise key,
selected-result provenance, absence branches, query semantics and history bounds are
not yet whole-shape accepted; no sidecar store has been implemented.

Only actual retained operands may populate a contrastive trial. Trace availability,
transient pressure or knowledge that a sample occurred does not authorize recovering
discarded bytes. Correlated readings of one sampling opportunity cannot count as
independent repeated trials. Baseline/response pairing must come from permitted
evidence under a separate source contract, never hidden dispatch ancestry.

No public source, persistent write, new schema/allocation, model, restore or corpus
promotion occurred. Source/version/hash receipts and old public qualification remain
preserved. The shared-acquisition/shared-control alternatives are retained candidates.
# Signal acquisition: component and opportunity checkpoint

2026-09-12. Primary-agent adversarial review under autonomous authorization.
The [signal-per-opportunity ruling](GENERAL_ATTENTION_INTEROCEPTIVE_UNIT_RESOLUTION.md)
is accepted. General ATTN-001 remains OPEN.
## Implemented component

`interoceptive-signal-selection-component/0.1-candidate` groups actual-shaped EMB
samples solely through a supplied channel→signal declaration for one explicit
opportunity. Equal-priority selection counts groups, not views. Every selected present
sample survives exactly; contradicting readouts are not fused or ranked by precision.
The detached one-use view has no discarded-sample archive or arbitrary payload lookup.

Separate finite parameters bound signals, views, selected groups and retained bytes.
The tests'3/3/4096/2 values are component specimens, not accepted public calibration.
The earlier sample-level source and qualification remain unchanged as a comparator.

[Eight component tests pass](INTEROCEPTIVE_SIGNAL_SELECTION_TESTS_REV2.json).
Revision1 preserves the earlier run; revision2 adds the explicit P-with-three-views
plus Q witness, showing that P consumes one slot and does not displace Q at capacity2.
[Seven source substitutions are detected](INTEROCEPTIVE_SIGNAL_SELECTION_REVIEW_REV1.json):
view-count charging, opportunity-from-time, dropped conflicting views, ignored byte
bound, reusable capability, duplicate observations and selection of an absent signal.

These tests authenticate neither the supplied signal declarations nor a physiological
source. Giving three component symbols different names does not prove three experienced
signals in a public model. Public source diversity remains an explicit gate.
## Opportunity identity reuse

The substrate has no need for a duplicate acquisition-opportunity namespace merely
to express the new gate. `ExperienceId/1106` already identifies a reserved, immutable
observer-side sensing envelope. For a future nonempty multi-view opportunity, propose
one actual frozen227 whose support set exactly covers the admitted present samples;
the gate's opportunity key is that existing ExperienceId. The dedicated adapter must
bind it to the live source, exact samples, observer, instant and declarations.

SO-A..C execute actual SEM reservation/freeze/settlement components. Two opportunities
at the same time and observer receive distinct IDs and pass settlement. Multiple
observations can support one envelope with one allocation. An opportunity with no
character-accessible evidence reserves no ExperienceId. Thus absence must not mint
a fake experience simply to supply a memory key; an all-unavailable source has no
durable candidate, with original-event accounting remaining trace-side.

The signal component's structural bigint opportunity is only a component parameter.
The proposed public carrier uses typed1106, not a naked scheduler event ID or an
omniscient event handle. This is a forward public-design refinement, not an allocation
or retroactive change to the component's tested input domain.

[Combined report](INTEROCEPTIVE_SIGNAL_INTEGRATION_TESTS_REV1.json):27 tests pass
(8 grouped gate,7 preserved sample gate,9 preserved attribution,3 SEM identity).
They do not qualify public multi-view SEM support matching, source admission or restore.
## Next public source gate

Current public EMB has one reserve-level signal. Three channels or resolutions of
that signal cannot provide the required three-signal contention experiment under
the accepted unit ruling. A genuinely multi-signal source requires an explicit
physiological/sensory model, not more labels in a grouping table.

The [prepared source proposal and architectural choice](GENERAL_ATTENTION_MULTISIGNAL_BODY_SOURCE_DECISION.md)
compare a bounded three-local-reserve body with multiple distinct sensory responses
to the existing single reserve. The former reuses accepted analytical operators but
extends the physical state domain; the latter preserves physical state but needs
new sensation/transduction semantics. Neither is implied by selecting signal-level
capacity. No public body source or durable carrier has been implemented while this
choice remains open.

Proposed durable direction remains a peer episodic acquisition with qualified
CharacterId ownership and a bounded exact sample basis keyed by opportunity/signal.
It must participate in ordinary declared memory reads/retention, not an unselected
sidecar. Its exact records and writes await source closure, whole symbolic acceptance,
separate allocation, model packaging and public proof. EVID269/270, old visual selection,
REG, old body/pressure profiles and corpus0.27.0 remain unchanged.

limits: Planning and captured hashes do not establish completed replay; later qualifications preserve component/native distinctions.
Later bounded completion supersedes routing only within named profiles, not all ideal-loop phenomena.
No runtime/test/build rerun, source gap closure, law/model/verdict/corpus/obligation status change or historical adequacy claim.
